tagline: Music player that removes the instruments automatically and keeps the voice
changelog: Brand-new native-style interface: Material Design with a light theme, top app bar, bottom navigation, floating Add button and a mini player
Dark and system themes in Settings — the Android status and navigation bars follow the app theme
New app icon (adaptive) and launch screen
Android back button works like in any app: closes the player, sheets and menus, returns to the Library, then sends the app to the background
Music keeps playing when the screen turns off or you switch apps
Library filters (All / Favorites), sort by recently added, title or artist, and ⋮ menus on every song and playlist
In-app dialogs for playlists and deletions — no more browser pop-ups
